label: IHandler
description: Defines the operations for receiving a request and linking to another handler.

methods.label: Handle(request)
methods.description: Receives a request through the IHandler interface.

methods.label: SetNext(handler: IHandler)
methods.description: Defines how to link an IHandler to the next handler.

label: EnemyHandler
description: Abstract base class that stores the next handler and forwards unmatched requests.
imageAlt: Pale spider resting in its web

fields.label: next: IHandler | null
fields.description: EnemyHandler stores the next handler, or null at the end of the chain.

methods.label: SetNext(handler: IHandler)
methods.description: Public method on EnemyHandler that stores the next handler.

methods.label: forward(request)
methods.description: Protected method that calls Handle(request) on the next handler if one exists.

label: SilkThread
description: The client sends requests through a single IHandler reference.
imageAlt: Faelina preparing the silk-thread trap that passes signals into the chain

fields.label: handler: IHandler
fields.description: SilkThread holds the entry point of the chain.

methods.label: SendSignal(request)
methods.description: Calls Handle(request) on the stored IHandler.

label: OrcHandler
description: Recognizes orc blood trails and handles the matching request.
imageAlt: Spider with a red marking on its back

methods.label: Handle(request)
methods.description: OrcHandler handles orc blood trails and calls the inherited forward method for other requests.
